stem.text: Under certain conditions, $\text{CCl}_4$ and $\text{H}_2\text{O}$ react as shown. The activation energy for the reaction is $+62\ \text{kJ mol}^{-1}$.
Which enthalpy profile diagram best fits this reaction?

A.alt: Enthalpy profile: reactants at a higher enthalpy than products, with one small activation peak between them

B.alt: Enthalpy profile: reactants at a lower enthalpy than products, with one large activation peak between them

C.alt: Enthalpy profile: reactants at a lower enthalpy than products, with one rounded peak between them

D.alt: Enthalpy profile: reactants at a higher enthalpy than products, with one large activation peak between them
